Definition: from G1 (as negative particle) and G1110; unknown:--unknown.
BiblicalUsage: Agnostos is 'unknown' — and it appears once, on an altar in Athens: 'TO THE UNKNOWN GOD.' Paul found the altar as he walked through the city, and he took it as his text: the God they worshipped without knowing, he declared to them.
TheologicalSignificance: An altar to an unknown god is Athens confessing it does not know, and this word only reads the inscription — Paul supplies the God they missed.
